items.prompt: One share trades at 100 cents and three at 200 cents. Which dollar VWAP follows N/(100*V)?

options.why: That is the price in cents, not dollars.
The cent-to-dollar conversion has been applied twice.
Notional 700 cent-shares divided by 4 shares is 175 cents, or 1.75 dollars.
The unweighted mean of the two prices ignores their unequal quantities.

items.explanation: Notional 700 cent-shares divided by 4 shares is 175 cents, or 1.75 dollars.
